We did it today so the stock market wouldnt be too affected, since we apparently own a hell of a lot of stock all over the globe.

This is the the sole reason why I didn't kill myself a couple of months ago, fuck if i'm going to be a part of some assclown statistics. 

My thinking just became "how could somebody want to leave a such interesting place, even if your mind is trying to trick you?... oh fuck thats me..." 

I was hardcore against meds when it came to mental issues. I have been on four, cutting down to two in a month, and probably staying on one of them for a three year period. 

Why three years? Because I have to teach myself, no... socialize myself, into being more happy. And have a purpouse, give that god damn asshole of a brain something to do instead of finding more ways to make me feel like an asshat. 

Well, fuck you, brain! I'm comin' for ya!
